overview: A complete fee management system for Akshay Classes with admin and student portals, built entirely with React and localStorage — no backend required. Admins manage students, track payments, and send notifications. Students view their fee status and payment history.
features: Role-based login for admin and student with localStorage persistence
Admin dashboard with revenue charts, student stats, and recent payments
Student management with add, edit, delete, search, filter, and pagination
Payment recording and history with month/status filtering
Notifications with bell badge, send modal, and toast alerts
Student portal with fee summary, payment history, and profile
Dark and light mode with localStorage persistence
Responsive mobile-first design with collapsible sidebar and drawer
Loading skeletons, empty states, confirmation modals throughout
Automatic demo seed data on first load
